just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on B in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:13.7) introduces B, centred on B. Phrase 4 (0:32.4) introduces Cs, centred on Cs. Phrase 6 (0:49.5) introduces E, centred on Eb. Phrase 13 (1:52.0) introduces Gs, centred on Gb. Phrase 25 (3:47.3) introduces Db, centred on Eb. The line peaks at B4 (503.2 Hz) at 11:54.7. It closes on the tonic (Gb4 → Gb4 → Cs4 → Gb4 → B4 → B2).
